Convex hull.fact: In geometry, the convex hull, convex envelope or convex closure of a shape is the smallest convex set that contains it. Convex metric space.fact: A metric space (X,d) is called Strongly Menger convex if for any two distinct points x and y in X, and for every number r between 0 and d(x,y), there exists a third point z in X lying between x and y, such that d(x,z)=r.
